trigger.P2l_failure: The frozen learned period head lost rank correlation outside 20-80 us even on exact SawFM components.
trigger.exploratory_diagnostic_only: A fixed FFT autocorrelation peak rule was explored on consumed P2l development data and is not evidence.

single_hypothesis: A non-trainable FFT autocorrelation period estimator can recover the wide-range periodic evidence already present in exact and P2f-separated SawFM components without changing the separator or classification system.

frozen_algorithm.autocorrelation: biased linear autocorrelation from zero-padded FFT length 2N, normalized by lag-zero
frozen_algorithm.selection: choose the earliest peak above max(absolute floor, selected fraction times strongest peak); otherwise choose strongest peak

controls: learned period head on exact component
learned period head on P2f-separated component plus frozen affine calibration
fixed analytic estimator on exact component
fixed analytic estimator on P2f-separated component

stop_rules.exact_fails: Stop analytic attachment; the fixed peak rule is not physically sufficient.
stop_rules.exact_passes_separated_fails: Do not alter the estimator on this seed; develop separator OOD robustness on a new seed.
stop_rules.all_pass: Freeze the analytic estimator and separately preregister full predicted-gate system attachment.
